races.paceDynamic: Prince Andorra looks the sole confirmed front runner in this field and should get an uncontested lead with the prominent runners Mo Anam Chara and Queen Of Newark sitting just behind. The majority of this field consists of hold-up horses including Cosmic Funk, Star Of Beauty, Six Wings, Schoolyard Days and Fay Og who will look to come from off the pace. With such a limited pace angle and only one horse keen to make the running, Prince Andorra should dictate terms and create a tactical race that will strongly favour front runners and prominent racers over the hold-up brigade.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Front Runner Wins
scenarios.trigger: If Prince Andorra gets an easy lead and dictates fractions
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace pressure allows the leader to control the race and kick clear when ready. Hold-up horses struggle to peg back a horse that's had everything his own way.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Mo Anam Chara or Queen Of Newark can track the leader perfectly
scenarios.body: The prominent runners get the ideal position behind an uncontested leader and can strike with a well-timed challenge. Their tactical advantage over the hold-up horses proves decisive.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Class Newcomers Arrive
scenarios.trigger: If Due In June or Monamie show significant improvement from their debuts
scenarios.body: The lightly-raced horses benefit from natural progression and their higher ratings translate to winning performances. Their unknown pace styles could also provide tactical flexibility.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Overcomes Bias
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes genuinely strong or one hold-up horse finds significant improvement
scenarios.body: A fast early pace or exceptional individual performance allows a closer to overcome the tactical disadvantage. Star Of Beauty or Cosmic Funk would need career-best efforts.

races.paceDynamic: Thrifty Of Digby is the sole confirmed front runner in this 18-runner handicap and will dictate terms from the start without pressure, creating a sustainable gallop throughout. The prominent runners Irish Rumour, Free Solo, Royal Impact, Queen Aethelflaed and Mercurial will track the leader but none are aggressive pace forcers. This sets up a moderate tempo that will gradually intensify from the 3-furlong pole as the large field begins to fan out. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses who can close from off the pace, as the modest early gallop will leave plenty in reserve for the final surge.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Patient Hold-Up Wins
scenarios.trigger: If Thrifty Of Digby maintains an even gallop and the prominent horses don't apply serious pressure until late
scenarios.body: The steady tempo allows closers to conserve energy and unleash their finishing kick when it matters most. Hold-up horses with proven finishing ability will have ideal conditions to sweep past tiring leaders.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If one of the prominent runners makes a decisive move turning for home while others hesitate
scenarios.body: Irish Rumour or Free Solo could capitalise on their forward position and superior form to kick clear before the hold-up horses can respond. Their tactical advantage allows them to steal a march on the field.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Leader Goes All Way
scenarios.trigger: If Thrifty Of Digby quickens the tempo from halfway and opens up a decisive advantage
scenarios.body: The front runner's proven stamina and lack of early pressure could allow a bold front-running victory. Hold-up horses may find themselves with too much ground to make up in the closing stages.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes truly crawling and the field bunches up turning for home
scenarios.body: A sprint finish develops where the best raw speed prevails regardless of position. The race becomes a lottery where any horse in the first dozen can win from any position.

races.paceDynamic: Galileo Springs will break forward and set a steady pace with Noble Honour, Karrygrant, and Changing Lanes tracking prominently in the first rank. With 17 runners but a clear lack of natural speed horses, this should develop into a moderate tempo that gradually builds through the long Roscommon straight. The large field creates tactical complications, but the absence of multiple speed duals means front runners won't be pressured early. This race shape strongly favours prominent racers and early leaders who can avoid traffic problems, as hold-up horses face a difficult task getting through from the back of such a large field on this tight track.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front Runners Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Galileo Springs and the prominent group maintain position without pressure
scenarios.body: The pace stays honest but manageable, allowing the early leaders to have enough left for the finish. Traffic becomes the key factor as hold-up horses struggle to find racing room.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the pace quickens meaningfully in the straight
scenarios.body: Those tracking just behind the leaders get the perfect trip as early pace-setters tire. The winner comes from horses positioned 4th-8th early.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If significant pace pressure develops unexpectedly
scenarios.body: The early speed collapses and creates openings for closers with the right draws and navigation. A strongly-run race suits the patient tactics.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Chaos Factor Decides
scenarios.trigger: If traffic problems or interference significantly impact the leading contenders
scenarios.body: The winner emerges from an unexpected source who avoided trouble rather than superior ability. Form lines become less reliable.

races.paceDynamic: Electric Beauty will take the field along as the sole confirmed front-runner, setting a sustainable rhythm with no pace pressure from the gate. Queen Lioness and Kilcrea Rock will track prominently behind the leader, while the bulk of this field comprises hold-up horses who will be relying on Electric Beauty to provide something to aim at. The lack of pace competition means Electric Beauty can dictate terms throughout, creating a tactical scenario where the front-runner controls the tempo completely. This race shape strongly favours front-runners and prominent racers who can position close to the pace, as the hold-up brigade will face a difficult task making up ground against a horse that hasn't been softened up by early pressure.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Electric Beauty Controls
scenarios.trigger: If Electric Beauty maintains her front-running position without serious early pressure
scenarios.body: She can dictate a steady tempo that suits her stamina while the hold-up horses struggle to make up the leeway. The prominent trackers get first run but the leader has enough left to hold on.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Queen Lioness or Kilcrea Rock can stalk the pace perfectly and time their challenge
scenarios.body: They get the benefit of a strong pace to aim at while avoiding the front-runner's workload. The tactical advantage of sitting just off the leader proves decisive in the straight.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Charges
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely in the middle stages creating a sprint finish
scenarios.body: The closers get their ideal scenario with plenty to aim at and can unleash late kicks. Syzygy's recent winning form becomes crucial in a bunched finish.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Surprising Speed Duel
scenarios.trigger: If Robot Rock or another prominent runner challenges Electric Beauty early for the lead
scenarios.body: The increased pace opens up the race for the hold-up horses to close into. The early leaders compromise each other and fade in the final furlong.

races.paceDynamic: Adel is the only confirmed front runner and will likely set an uncontested lead with Tenacious sitting prominently behind. The large field of 14 runners contains mostly hold-up horses who will be content to settle behind the modest early pace. This creates a tactical scenario where Adel can dictate terms without pressure, while the hold-up brigade may struggle to make up ground from the back of such a big field on this track. This race shape clearly favours prominent runners and those with early tactical speed who can position close to the pace.

scenarios.label: A

scenarios.trigger: If Adel gets an easy lead without early pressure from the field
scenarios.body: Adel can control the fractions and kick clear when the pace lifts, while the mass of hold-up horses get caught in traffic behind. The lack of early pace pressure means front runners and prominent racers get ideal positioning.

scenarios.label: B

scenarios.trigger: If the hold-up horses get bunched up turning for home in the big field
scenarios.body: The large contingent of hold-up horses will struggle for racing room, allowing the early positioned horses to capitalize. Those with prominent styles or recent winning form can exploit the congestion behind.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Strong Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If Adel sets fractions too strong trying to make all or gets pressured early
scenarios.body: The unfit Adel fades dramatically in the final furlong, creating opportunities for closers with stamina. Hold-up horses with strong finishing kicks can sweep past the tiring pace-setters.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider Breakthrough
scenarios.trigger: If the main fancies underperform due to fitness or traffic issues

The sustainable early pace and long straight at Roscommon strongly favours hold-up horses who can time their runs perfectly.

scenarios.title: Late Closer Breakthrough
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes strong enough to bring hold-up horses into play
scenarios.body: Grey Fable or Whosethebestboy find clear runs from the back as the prominent horses tire from tracking a solid gallop. The 1m4f trip and good ground help their finishing kicks.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Traffic-Free Outsider
scenarios.trigger: If one of the hold-up horses gets an ideal passage through
scenarios.body: Sayidah New Bay or Burlington House benefit from getting first run on the field when others are still searching for room. Their fresher finishing kick catches the prominent horses who've done more work.

watchPoints.text: Prom Queen getting a soft lead could prove decisive as she showed winning form when uncontested at Gowran Park
Traffic problems will be severe for hold-up horses in this 18-runner field, particularly around the bend
Tassarolo and Mapa tracking the leader will have ideal positions if they can avoid early interference
Multiple horses carry warnings about fading in the finish, making late betting moves suspicious
The large contingent of apprentice and conditional jockeys increases the likelihood of tactical errors
